object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: On a branch, revise the target and acknowledge the link, then merge the branch into main, merge main into the branch, and fast-forward main. Separately, resolve a merge with target text neither side had; find the last change after a merge that took one side's text; and compare each object's last change with git log -1 over its object file and figure on random histories with branches, merges and shuffled commit dates. Expected: after each merge that takes one parent's target files the link stays OK, with the branch's revising commit as the last change; the resolution with new text makes the link suspect with the merge as the last change; the last change equals git log's in each case.
